research_role: one full article-level event extraction after Stage 1 pass; no outcome join or trading action
selection_basis: V3.7 passed every predeclared Stage 1 reliability requirement in two independent 114-headline runs. Both runs produced 114 schema-valid records, zero evidence fallbacks, exact categorical agreement, affected-assets mean Jaccard 1.0, and zero continuous-field difference. The only change from v3.6 is a closed exact allowlist for wrapped-BTC aliases, regression-tested against the failed v3.6 raw batch. This config opens one new full extraction from record zero over the frozen 39,393-headline input. No failed v3.6 checkpoint, market outcome, predictive metric, threshold, or trading result is reused or consulted.

btc_asset_alias_policy.unlisted_values: preserve then apply the unchanged v3.5 validator

completion_gate.decision: all requirements must pass before the extraction artifact can be frozen for downstream design

prohibited: reusing the failed v3.6 checkpoint under the v3.7 contract
canonicalizing affected-assets values outside the frozen exact allowlist
joining market outcomes during full extraction
computing predictive metrics, selecting a target or horizon, or tuning a threshold
creating an action, position size, backtest, or Tech overlay
running more than one LLM worker
continuing compute at NVIDIA GPU temperature 75 C or above
